figures.caption: Figure 1: CSSPD architecture. Three streams (At, Yt, Xt/S) are embedded and passed through L independent Mamba SSM layers (O(T )) to produce ãt, ỹt, x̃t. A SCM-gated CausalGatedMixer (9) fuses them into the balancing representation BRt. Domain confusion (dashed red) suppresses I(BRt;At) via gradient reversal but inadvertently suppresses I(BRt;Ht+k) and I(BRt;Xt). CPC (solid green) restores temporal MI I(BRt;Ht+k); LIM (solid orange) restores covariate MI I(BRt;Xt). The parallel decoder (10) receives two distinct inputs: a stop-gradient copy BR⊥ t (dashed blue, left-entering) encoding patient state, and TrtEnc(āt+1:t+τ ) (solid black, bottom-entering) encoding the counterfactual intervention; together they produce all τmax predictions simultaneously. CSSD omits the CPC and LIM heads.

Table 1: Cancer Simulation: Mean normalised RMSE averaged over τ = 1–6 steps and 5 random seeds (lower is better; bold = best per column). ¶Baseline results are reproduced. ‡CHSD and CHSPD exhibit high variance at γ≥2.
